First, convert 15 weeks and 6 days to days:  
15 weeks = 15 × 7 = 105 days  
Add 6 days → 111 days before 1769-05-02.

1769-05-02 minus 111 days:  
April has 30 days, so back 2 days → 1769-04-30.  
Remaining 109 days earlier:  
March has 31 days → back 31 → 1769-03-31 → 78 days left.  
February 1769 has 28 days (not leap year) → back 28 → 1769-02-03 → 50 days left.  
January has 31 days → back 31 → 1768-12-31 → 19 days left.  
December 1768 has 31 days → back 19 → 1768-12-12.

FINAL_ANSWER: 1768-12-12
